metadata.description: Three-width doorway slice of the sealed Robot SF 0.0.8 evaluation: 14 planner arms, widths 2.2/2.8/3.6 m, and 30 seeds at requested horizon 600 with dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (1,260 expected episode identities). The scenario horizon cap is 400 steps. The Social Navigation Quality Index (SNQI) is advisory only; this slice makes no SNQI ranking claim.
